purpose: Represent source pages that visibly contain content/header evidence for more than one semantic lesson without fabricating page splits or double-counting physical pages.

rules.physical_page_identity: A retained physical source page is counted once in physical page totals and receives one primary physical classification.
rules.semantic_lesson_membership: A physical page MAY carry membership edges to more than one verified semantic lesson when source-local evidence explicitly shows multiple lesson headers/content on that same page.
rules.lesson_page_counter: lesson_pages counts UNIQUE retained physical pages whose primary classification is instructional lesson content; it MUST NOT sum membership edges and MUST NOT double-count shared pages.
rules.lesson_membership_counter: If needed, membership edges are reported separately and never substituted for the unique physical lesson_pages counter.
rules.boundary_rule: Never fabricate non-overlapping page ranges when the immutable source itself places multiple lesson boundaries on one physical page. Preserve the shared page and record all evidence-backed memberships.
rules.nonlesson_rule: Verified assessment/review/cover/tail pages remain nonlesson physical classifications even when neighboring lesson boundaries are close.
rules.uncertainty_rule: If shared membership is not explicit in source-local evidence, keep it NOT VERIFIED/review_required rather than infer it.

evidence_basis: Existing finalized educational reconstructions count physical lesson pages as unique retained pages and require retained-page accounting without duplication.
Arabic Part 1 source-local complete visual review explicitly proves 11 physical pages containing two or three numbered instructional lesson headers.
The immutable physical source cannot be truthfully represented by invented page splits; semantic membership and physical-page counting therefore must be separate dimensions.
